name: Royce
arena: Watson / Northside: the last room of the All Foods Plant, with crates and a raised platform
weak: The battery (power unit) on the back of his Militech Centaur exosuit, left side: once it is gone he stops raising the shield
steps: From the **raised platform**, tag him and the Maelstromer with him before you go down.
Sneak in for a **stealth takedown**: it wrecks the battery and takes **25 %** of his health. Otherwise shoot or grenade the battery on his back.
Without the battery he can no longer raise the shield. Use the **crates as cover**: his shots come at waist height.
Lean on quickhacks: **Reboot Optics** so he loses you, **Overheat**, **Weapon Glitch** (staggers him) and **Short Circuit**.
strategy: The fight only happens on the **hostile route** of The Pickup: if you did not kill him in the meeting and it ends in a shootout. Royce pilots a **Militech Centaur exosuit** with a shield and a cannon, with one more Maelstromer at his side. If you paid with Militech's **infected chip**, he arrives weakened. If you take too long to answer him in the meeting, he shoots you: that is a reload, not a fight.
reward: **Chaos** (iconic pistol, only if he dies) and **€$3,000** for the kill.
note: Killing him is required for Chaos and Brick's payoff; letting him live is required for Doom Doom: the two are mutually exclusive. The Body takedown in the meeting skips the fight; the wiki thinks it is a bug that this also makes Gilchrist appear and Meredith die.

name: Scavenger leader
arena: Westbrook / Japantown: the Scavenger den (room 1237), the room that opens onto the terrace
weak: Exposed while something distracts him
steps: Follow the optional objectives: **go out onto the terrace** to catch him off guard.
**Hack the lamp** and wait for him to stare at it: take him down or shoot him in the head.
Alternatively: **Reboot Optics** then headshots, or flank him by **climbing through the left-side window**.
strategy: The tutorial fight of The Rescue: one enemy tougher than the rest, teaching you to distract and flank. No traps, no phases.
reward: Nothing special; his computer holds a message hinting at a run-in between the gang and Viktor.
note: Tutorial fight: how you handle it changes nothing.

name: Sasquatch
arena: Pacifica / Coastview: the Grand Imperial Mall cinema
weak: The **glowing implant on her back** (the "Juicer", per game8): destroy it and she stops regenerating and slowly loses health. game8 also calls her weak to thermal damage (unverified in 2.x)
steps: If nobody detects you in the whole mall, the cinema gates stay open and you can **sneak past without a fight**.
If you fight, **finish fast**: the NetWatch netrunner is frying your brain the whole time.
Go for the **implant on her back**: Short Circuit can pop it; Overheat, Cripple Movement and System Collapse help.
Her hammer combos hit hard but are slow, with seconds between swings: **dodge, circle and punish her back** in the gap.
strategy: Matilda K. Rose, leader of the Animals, in I Walk the Line. She fights with a hammer in an open space. Her abilities: Berserk, Sandevistan Mk.1, Kerenzikov, frag grenades and Juice Tank. Cyberware Malfunction shuts off her Sandevistan and Kerenzikov.
reward: **Sasquatch's Hammer** (iconic hammer, missable) and a **€$15,000** bounty (wiki; game8 says 16,000).
note: game8's Kabayan Foods route skips both the van and the fight. It is unknown whether bosses keep pre-2.0 weaknesses, so the thermal tip is a hint, not a rule.

name: Akira
arena: Cyberspace: Johnny's memory of Alt's 2013 extraction from Arasaka
steps: Use the gear the memory gives you; your own loadout does not come with you.
Get into cover and **let Rogue and Santiago draw his attention**.
Shoot him while he is busy with them and change cover when he comes for you.
strategy: The Arasaka bodyguard ("Hulk from hell") guarding the mainframe in Johnny's memory, inside Transmission. Sources give no move list: treat him as an elite enemy.
note: Sources document neither his moves nor his loot.

name: Placide
arena: Pacifica / Coastview: Pacifica Serenity Bible Church
weak: He tends to stand still for a long time: headshots work. He is **immune to System Collapse**
steps: Do not spend RAM on System Collapse: it does nothing to him.
If there is an access point, game8 suggests using it first to weaken him (2.0 removed Breach Protocol on enemies, but access points remain).
Use the moments he stands still for **headshots**; Cyberware Malfunction shuts off his Sandevistan and Kerenzikov.
Once he drops, take the **Chapel Access Token** from his body to open the church door.
strategy: Only if you sided with NetWatch (Bryce Mosley) in I Walk the Line: in Transmission you fight Placide and the remaining Voodoo Boys to get out of the church. His abilities: Combat Stim, Sandevistan Mk.2, Charge Jump, Kerenzikov and EMP grenades.
reward: **Chapel Access Token** (opens the church door) and his loot.
note: On Placide's branch there is no fight: the Voodoo Boys cross the Blackwall.

name: Sandayu Oda
arena: Westbrook / Japantown: the parade, as soon as you disconnect the netrunner
weak: His **Oni mask** disrupts smart bullets: destroy it with damage, with **Cyberware Malfunction** (instant) or with a stealth takedown
steps: Take off the **Oni mask** first (Cyberware Malfunction is fastest).
Against his **Mantis Blades** dashes, keep moving and shoot his head as he comes in.
His **TKI-20 Shingen** smart SMG homes in: break line of sight at corners; **Weapon Glitch** shuts it off.
When he hides under **optical camo** to heal, keep damaging him; **Friendly Mode** on the cameras lets you track him.
He carries a grenade: **Detonate Grenade** sets it off. Stun grenades and a katana also help.
strategy: Arasaka cyber-ninja trained by Takemura, in Play It Safe. The fight starts as soon as you disconnect the netrunner. He carries Mantis Blades, the Shingen, optical camo, flashbangs, Combat Stim and light subdermal armor.
reward: **Jinchu-Maru** (iconic katana, missable).
note: **Sparing him matters:** Takemura asks you not to kill him. If you incapacitate him, he helps V in Totalimmortal on the Devil ending, and Smasher comments that you spared him.

name: Nash
arena: Badlands / Rocky Ridge: the Corp-Bud Mine
weak: Cyberware Malfunction shuts off his Sandevistan and Kerenzikov
steps: The fight is optional: it only happens if you agree to help Panam take revenge.
Bring a **shotgun** or a strong melee weapon (game8).
Once he drops, **grab his Widow Maker** and use it on the reinforcements.
strategy: A Wraiths leader in Ghost Town. Abilities: Combat Stim, Sandevistan Mk.2, Kerenzikov, Charge Jump and biohazard grenades, so bring something to clear poison.
reward: **Widow Maker** (iconic; if you skip him here, it comes in Queen of the Highway).
note: If you do not fight him here, he dies later, in Queen of the Highway.

name: Adam Smasher
arena: City Center / Corpo Plaza: Arasaka Tower
weak: The right side of his chest, behind armor plating you can shoot off; electrical damage, and EMP briefly blocks most of his attacks
steps: **Phase 1, close range:** punches and short-range projectiles. Never stand still.
Shoot off the chest plating and his **right arm** (on your left, facing him) to take away his melee.
**Phase 2, long range:** with his right half wrecked he backs off and fires rockets aimed where you were: keep moving at all times.
On the Devil route, Arasaka ninjas join at about **50 %**: one or two frag grenades deal with them.
**Phase 3:** he is weakened; finish him.
strategy: Since 2.1 Smasher uses **Sandevistan**, is more relentless and adapts to your build, so older guides are only partly right (PowerPyx's tips on the back rocket launcher are pre-2.0). Bring plenty of ammo and electrical quickhacks. Cyberware Malfunction helps against his Sandevistan.
reward: The **Access Token** (loot his body) and progress in Belly of the Beast or Totalimmortal, depending on the route.
note: At the end you can spare him; sources document no consequence. He comments on earlier choices, such as sparing Oda.

name: Razor Hugh
arena: Pacifica / Coastview: the Grand Imperial Mall, from 12:01 AM
weak: His torso: his new abdominal muscles have not settled yet (Viktor), and gut punches stagger him
steps: Win the four district fights first: the championship final needs all of them.
He is fast and hits hard, but telegraphs badly: **block at the right moment** for a slowed-time counter.
Put your punches **into his gut**. With Gorilla Arms, charged punches break his guard and can stun-lock him.
strategy: Beat on the Brat comes from Coach Fred in Megabuilding H10 after The Rescue, during The Ripperdoc. Razor Hugh is the Beat on the Brat final. Gorilla Arms and recovery implants are allowed. Fred offers double money to throw the fight.
reward: **€$50,000** (+€$20,000 for taking the dive).
note: Fist fight: always non-lethal.

name: Esquerdo & Certo
arena: Watson / Kabuki: the rooftop south-west of Judy's apartment (Bellevue & Allen)
weak: Two bodies sharing one mind: focusing one eases the pressure
steps: Keep **both of them in front of you**: do not let them surround you.
Back off toward an edge or a corner so they cannot flank you.
Focus your punches **on one body** until it drops.
strategy: Beat on the Brat comes from Coach Fred in Megabuilding H10 after The Rescue, during The Ripperdoc. A two-on-one fight in Kabuki. The tactic is a reasonable inference: the wiki has no walkthrough for this fight.
reward: €$6,000–12,000, 602 XP and 901 Street Cred.
note: Fist fight. The tactic is unverified.

name: Buck Arnold
arena: Santo Domingo / Arroyo
steps: Eat and take boosters first: **2–3 of his hits knock you out**.
With **Body 8** you can add his O'Five rifle to the bet (€$18,000 instead of €$6,000).
On the high bet his 6th Street posse turns hostile when you win and guns are allowed: get ready for the shootout.
strategy: Beat on the Brat comes from Coach Fred in Megabuilding H10 after The Rescue, during The Ripperdoc. One of the hardest fist fights. Dodge and punish; do not trade blows.
reward: **O'Five** (iconic sniper rifle, optional) and the winnings (€$24,000 on his body on the high bet).
note: Fist fight; on the high bet killing him is optional.

name: Rhino
arena: Santo Domingo / Rancho Coronado: the Animals gym
steps: A free fight, no stake.
She knocks you out in **2–4 punches**: keep dodging and only hit after her attacks.
During Gig: For My Son, do not start open combat in the gym: it completes the gig but loses the vendor.
strategy: Beat on the Brat comes from Coach Fred in Megabuilding H10 after The Rescue, during The Ripperdoc. Rhino hits very hard; mobility is the key.
reward: Access to the Animals' **melee weapon vendor**, 1,919 XP and 2,878 Street Cred.
note: Fist fight.

name: César Diego Ruiz
arena: Heywood / The Glen: the court
weak: Clear tell on his signature jump punch
steps: Before the fight you can drop recovery items and non-lethal melee weapons on the court to pick up mid-fight.
Back off with room on your right.
When he blurs forward and jumps, **circle right**: he is wide open for a few seconds.
Punch his head, back off and recover stamina. Gorilla Arms work.
strategy: Beat on the Brat comes from Coach Fred in Megabuilding H10 after The Rescue, during The Ripperdoc. César bets his car on the fight in The Glen.
reward: **Villefort Alvarado "Vato"** and/or €$20,000 (your choice).
note: Fist fight. Letting him keep the car or the money changes his later scene.

name: Militech Chimera
arena: Pacifica / Dogtown, after its fall
weak: The **glowing yellow weak spots** (scan it to see any left); its database entry says it is vulnerable to attacks from above
steps: Shoot the **yellow spots**; **jump** the laser when it sweeps the floor and change cover often: it destroys cover.
At about **70 %** **repair drones** appear: destroy them or it heals.
At about **40 %** it floods the floor with **toxic gas**: get to high ground until it clears.
At **2 %** it stops: **jump on it** and use "Finish it off".
strategy: The six-legged tank of Spider and the Fly, with a turret, a laser cannon, a dart cannon and missile launchers. Earlier in the same job you support it against Hansen's people and then flee it until the elevator arrives. You fight it already damaged. Short Circuit and EMP do more against machines.
reward: Its **core** (picked up at the start of the next job).
note: A machine. The finisher depends on your arms: Gorilla Arms rip the core out, Mantis Blades stab it, anything else uses Myers's grenade. Optional objectives: destroy every weak spot and the repair drones.

name: Militech Cerberus
arena: Pacifica / West Wind Estate and Dogtown: the Cynosure facility
weak: None: it takes no damage and no quickhacks
steps: Do not shoot: it draws Cerberus in. Throw a grenade far away as a decoy if you need it to leave.
Move with **Dash**, Lynx Paws, crouch-sprinting and **Optical Camo**. Sandevistan malfunctions here and drains your health.
Hide in the rooms it will not enter (the closet outside Engineering, Data Analysis Research, Experimental Prototyping, Neural Networking, Datafort Central Command).
The game autosaves every time it enters the vents. It falls in a scripted sequence at Core Control.
strategy: In Somewhat Damaged (Reed path) it is the only enemy in the game you cannot fight. It follows a fixed patrol unless provoked, and the HUD glitches when it is near. Being detected is almost always death, as is failing the grate prompt.
reward: **Behavioral system component** (missable; with a spec it opens This Corrosion: Erebus or Militech Canto Mk.6).
note: A chase, not a fight.

name: Kurt Hansen
arena: Pacifica / Dogtown: EBM Petrochem Stadium
weak: Few documented: he has Heavy Subdermal Armor, so armor penetration helps; Cyberware Malfunction shuts off his Sandevistan and Kerenzikov
steps: Drop the **two soldiers** with him first.
**Phase 1, ranged:** LMG and revolver in an arena with little cover: stack quickhacks or close in.
**Phase 2:** he draws a knife: dash-ins, a ground slam, knives thrown at your legs and a grab if you get too far away.
Against the knife, **backpedal while shooting**. Expect the switch from 75 % health.
strategy: Reed path of Firestarter only. His abilities: Sandevistan Mk.3, Kerenzikov, Charge Jump and flashbangs. Sources disagree on when he switches to the knife: 75 % per game8, 50 % per the wiki.
reward: **Fang**, **Bald Eagle** and **Wild Dog** (iconics, missable) and the stadium security shard.
note: On the Songbird path you do not fight him: you escape.

name: MaxTac squad (Faye Russo, Asher Peterson, Dallas Foster, Jasper Collins)
arena: Pacifica / West Wind Estate: the skybridge ambush
weak: Each has a role: Russo (assault), Peterson (Mantis Blades), Foster (heavy, exosuit) and Collins (netrunner)
steps: **Save before the convoy arrives.** In the plan review pick turrets or mines and one of the three start positions.
Wipe out the NCPD escort; then the four officers come out of the truck.
Silence the **netrunner (Collins)** early; the Self-ICE implant from Nix helps against his hacks.
Keep **Peterson** and his Mantis Blades at range, and use armor penetration on Foster.
strategy: In Black Steel In The Hour of Chaos (Reed path), after the NCPD escort four named MaxTac officers come out of the truck. MaxTac wear strong armor and run Sandevistan Mk.3: Cyberware Malfunction helps.
reward: **Crowbar** (iconic, from this job); later, the **MaxTac Mantis Blades** if you took Yoko's offer for Mr. Hands.
note: Songbird escapes in the truck whatever you do.

name: Solomon Reed
arena: Morro Rock: the NCX Spaceport shuttle platform
steps: Songbird path only.
Pick "Reed, dammit!" or "Draw Weapon": a slow-motion shootout starts and V kills him.
If you refuse to lay Songbird down without a fight, V dies (game over).
strategy: A scripted standoff in The Killing Moon, not a normal boss fight: the dialogue decides it.
reward: **Pariah** (his iconic pistol).
note: He cannot be left alive in this standoff. It leads to the King of Wands ending.

name: Boris Ribakov
arena: Pacifica / Dogtown: Organitopia, Terra Cognita
weak: Cyberware Malfunction shuts off his Sandevistan; Short Circuit and EMP for his drones
steps: **Phase 1:** he drops from the ceiling and snipes with a **Nekomata** from the catwalks, with optical camo, Sandevistan, smoke and flashbangs: break line of sight and watch for his laser.
Once he loses 30 % he vanishes and **Griffin drones** come in: shoot them down.
On the ground he fights with the **Pizdets** smart SMG and holographic decoys (low health, no damage) and quickhacks you: ignore the decoys.
At **5 %** more decoys appear and he can use System Collapse: finish him fast.
strategy: Boss of Mr. Hands' gig Spy in the Jungle (Tier 3, opens in Get It Together). His fight was reworked in 2.1.
reward: **Pizdets** (iconic smart SMG) and the shard "Contract Objective: Terminate Katya Karelina".
note: In the same gig, sparing Ana later opens the side jobs Money for Nothing and No Easy Way Out.

name: Yasha Ivanov
arena: Pacifica / Dogtown: Longshore Stacks, top floor of the Los Osos motel
steps: Reach the top floor with full health and ammo: he ambushes you before you get to Leon Rinder.
Get into cover as soon as it starts and fight with whatever works best for you.
strategy: A "large scavenger" who ambushes V in Mr. Hands' gig The Man Who Killed Jason Foreman (Tier 3, opens in Get It Together). His fight was improved in 2.1, but he has no wiki page: his moves are undocumented.
reward: The gig pay: €$8,000, 1,832 XP and 167 Street Cred.
note: Moves unverified.

name: Minotaur mech (The Heist)
arena: Watson / Arasaka Waterfront: Konpeki Plaza
weak: A machine: **Short Circuit** deals extra damage and **EMP** affects it; it cannot be knocked out
steps: Hack it before it sees you: **Cyberpsychosis** turns a Minotaur friendly.
Otherwise use Short Circuit and EMP grenades.
Shoot the exposed parts from hard cover: it carries a Smart Mk.31 HMG.
strategy: The wiki lists it as an optional mini-boss in The Heist. A two-legged, remote-controlled robot.
note: Machine: can only be destroyed.

name: Wesley Hunt
arena: Pacifica / Dogtown: the Anatomicon, Terra Cognita
weak: Cyberware Malfunction shuts off his Sandevistan and Kerenzikov
steps: Fight **at range**: he carries a katana and closes fast with Dash.
Break his rushes with grenades or control quickhacks; you cannot grab him (Break Hold).
When he hides under optical camo, scan and wait for his next charge.
strategy: A Dogtown cyberjunkie: a cyberware user hooked on drugs into something like cyberpsychosis. There is no fixer, no reward for sparing them and no achievement; they drop loot and a shard. A Blade homage: katana, Sandevistan Mk.1, Kerenzikov, optical camo, Dash, Break Hold and flashbangs.
reward: Katana, **Haemocide**, a **Cyberware Capacity Shard** and a shard.
note: Appears as soon as V leaves the Kress Street Hideout during Lucretia My Reflection.

name: Maggie Isley
arena: Pacifica / Dogtown: Organitopia, Terra Cognita
weak: Cyberware Malfunction shuts off her Sandevistan and Kerenzikov. She has **Anti-Combustion Coating**: fire will not help
steps: Do not use thermal damage or incendiary grenades.
Keep away from her **Mantis Blades**: backpedal while shooting and dodge her Dash.
Shut off her Sandevistan with Cyberware Malfunction and finish her with a shotgun.
strategy: A Dogtown cyberjunkie: a cyberware user hooked on drugs into something like cyberpsychosis. There is no fixer, no reward for sparing them and no achievement; they drop loot and a shard. An ex-corpo bioengineer working on Phant, the scavs' drug. Mantis Blades, Sandevistan Mk.1, Kerenzikov, Dash and Anti-Combustion Coating.
reward: **Neurotoxin Knife**, **Boomerang**, Black Lace and a shard.
note: Appears as soon as V leaves the Kress Street Hideout during Lucretia My Reflection.

name: Jacob Bernard
arena: Pacifica / Dogtown: the basketball court, Longshore Stacks
weak: Cyberware Malfunction shuts off his Sandevistan and Kerenzikov
steps: He only spawns once **4 other cyberjunkies** are down.
He carries a Cut-o-Matic: do not let him close in; shoot while backing off.
Shut off his Sandevistan with Cyberware Malfunction when he dashes in.
strategy: A Dogtown cyberjunkie: a cyberware user hooked on drugs into something like cyberpsychosis. There is no fixer, no reward for sparing them and no achievement; they drop loot and a shard. A former Toronto Falcons player: Cut-o-Matic, Sandevistan Mk.1, Kerenzikov and Dash.
reward: Loot and a shard.
note: Spawns after 4 other cyberjunkies are down.

name: Garry Bates
arena: Pacifica / Dogtown: Brave Atlas, Golden Pacific
weak: A sniper: up close he loses his edge
steps: Move between cover: he snipes with a **Nekomata** and his laser gives him away.
**Close in through the smoke** he throws himself.
Once on him, shut off his Sandevistan with Cyberware Malfunction and finish him.
strategy: A Dogtown cyberjunkie: a cyberware user hooked on drugs into something like cyberpsychosis. There is no fixer, no reward for sparing them and no achievement; they drop loot and a shard. A Nekomata sniper with Sandevistan, smoke grenades, flashbangs and Smokey Eye.
reward: A **Cyberware Capacity Shard**, Black Lace and new **Airdrops** spawning at Brave Atlas.
note: Appears as soon as V leaves the Kress Street Hideout during Lucretia My Reflection. Defeating him makes new Airdrops spawn at Brave Atlas.

name: Cody Crosby
arena: Pacifica / Dogtown: High Peak, southern Luxor Heights
weak: Heavy Subdermal Armor: use armor-piercing weapons
steps: Keep him **at range**: he fights with a baseball bat and leaps at you (Charge Jump).
Do not try to grab him (Break Hold).
Use armor-piercing weapons and quickhacks.
strategy: A Dogtown cyberjunkie: a cyberware user hooked on drugs into something like cyberpsychosis. There is no fixer, no reward for sparing them and no achievement; they drop loot and a shard. Baseball bat, Break Hold, Charge Jump, Dash and flashbangs.
reward: Black Lace, an expired MRE and a shard.
note: Appears as soon as V leaves the Kress Street Hideout during Lucretia My Reflection.

name: David Dover
arena: Pacifica / Dogtown: the sewer under the Zhirafa building opposite Los Osos
weak: He has a **Second Heart**: expect him to get back up once
steps: Bring something to clear poison: he throws biohazard grenades and flashbangs.
Keep away from his machete.
When he drops, **stay ready**: he gets up once more.
strategy: A Dogtown cyberjunkie: a cyberware user hooked on drugs into something like cyberpsychosis. There is no fixer, no reward for sparing them and no achievement; they drop loot and a shard. Machete, biohazard grenades and flashbangs, Second Heart.
reward: Food and a shard.
note: Appears as soon as V leaves the Kress Street Hideout during Lucretia My Reflection. Killing him starts Chester Hamilton's 6-hour timer.

name: Chester Hamilton
arena: Pacifica / Dogtown: the Founding Our Future Expo
weak: Only Light Subdermal Armor
steps: He spawns **6 in-game hours after** David Dover dies.
Break line of sight from his flashbangs.
His armor is light: any weapon works.
strategy: A Dogtown cyberjunkie: a cyberware user hooked on drugs into something like cyberpsychosis. There is no fixer, no reward for sparing them and no achievement; they drop loot and a shard. Combat Stim and flashbangs.
reward: Black Lace, Jellytricity and a shard.
note: Spawns 6 in-game hours after David Dover dies (the wiki flags this for verification).

name: Jacqueline Peele
arena: Pacifica / Dogtown: the alley west of the Black Sapphire
weak: A netrunner: fragile up close
steps: Bring **Self-ICE**: it negates one of her hacks.
**Break line of sight** while she hacks you.
**Rush her**: up close she does not last. Cyberware Malfunction shuts off her Sandevistan.
strategy: A Dogtown cyberjunkie: a cyberware user hooked on drugs into something like cyberpsychosis. There is no fixer, no reward for sparing them and no achievement; they drop loot and a shard. She netruns, plus Sandevistan and Ticon.
reward: A **Cyberware Capacity Shard**, Black Lace and a shard.
note: Appears as soon as V leaves the Kress Street Hideout during Lucretia My Reflection.

name: Sean McMillan
arena: Pacifica / Dogtown: the rooftop of a damaged block behind Dream Gig
weak: Only Light Subdermal Armor
steps: He spawns once **4 cyberjunkies** are down.
He carries an L-69 Zhuo shotgun: fight at mid range.
Break line of sight from his flashbangs.
strategy: A Dogtown cyberjunkie: a cyberware user hooked on drugs into something like cyberpsychosis. There is no fixer, no reward for sparing them and no achievement; they drop loot and a shard. L-69 Zhuo shotgun, Combat Stim and flashbangs.
reward: Food, Black Lace, a shard and notes on a table.
note: Spawns after 4 cyberjunkies are down (the wiki flags this for verification).

name: Greg Wilson
arena: Pacifica / Dogtown: ground level below the Luxor High Wellness Spa
weak: Cyberware Malfunction shuts off his Sandevistan and Kerenzikov
steps: He spawns after Gig: Roads to Redemption (Mr. Hands' Tier 4, after Firestarter).
Dodge his opening rush (Sandevistan, Kerenzikov, Dash).
Shut off his cyberware with Cyberware Malfunction and punish him with a shotgun.
strategy: A Dogtown cyberjunkie: a cyberware user hooked on drugs into something like cyberpsychosis. There is no fixer, no reward for sparing them and no achievement; they drop loot and a shard. Sandevistan, Kerenzikov, Dash, Combat Stim and flashbangs.
reward: Black Lace, Jellytricity and a shard.
note: Spawns after Gig: Roads to Redemption, which opens after Firestarter.

name: Andrew Newman
arena: Pacifica / Dogtown: the Luxor High Wellness Spa
weak: A sniper: up close he loses his edge
steps: He spawns after the side job Balls to the Wall (which opens after Spider and the Fly).
He snipes with an **Ashura**: move between cover and watch for his laser.
Close in through the smoke and shut off his Sandevistan with Cyberware Malfunction.
strategy: A Dogtown cyberjunkie: a cyberware user hooked on drugs into something like cyberpsychosis. There is no fixer, no reward for sparing them and no achievement; they drop loot and a shard. An Ashura sniper with Sandevistan, smoke grenades and flashbangs.
reward: A **Cyberware Capacity Shard**, components and a shard.
note: Spawns after Balls to the Wall; that job becomes unavailable once Firestarter is done.
